purpose.zh: 活动两侧髋关节的内旋和外旋
purpose.en: Moves both hips through internal and external rotation.

text.zh: 脚跟压稳，双膝一起翻到另一侧
text.en: Heels planted, turn both knees over to the other side

text.zh: 上身尽量坐直，双手往前伸，别往后靠
text.en: Sit as tall as you can, arms reaching forward; don't lean back

text.zh: 两边都落成 90/90：前腿小腿横在身前，后腿小腿朝后
text.en: Land in 90/90 each side: front shin across, back shin pointing back

text.zh: 膝盖跟着髋转，别硬拧膝盖
text.en: Let the hips turn the knees; don't twist at the knee

commonErrors.zh: 翻得太快，落地没停稳就往回翻
commonErrors.en: Rushing the switch without settling into each side

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼就缩小翻转幅度或手撑在身后辅助，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knees hurt, turn less or put your hands behind you. Stop if it still hurts.

training.source: legacy-fix-r1 s-9090-lfx1 动画节奏（8 s 一个往返：右前停约 1 s → 双膝翻到左前约 2 s → 停约 1.5 s → 翻回右前约 2 s → 停）；Flare 热身文案：脚跟压稳，双膝翻到另一侧，上身尽量坐直

decision: 开哥 2026-11-21 选定左右换髋重做版（drill-anim/specs/s-9090-lfx1.js）作为 s-9090 的 Hub 动作与文字；原 catalog/production/v3-text/s-9090.json（单侧前倾静态保持）保留未改，本文件为替代版本。

reminders.zh: 脚跟压稳，双膝一起翻过去
reminders.en: Heels planted, both knees turn over together

reminders.zh: 上身坐直，双手往前伸，别往后靠
reminders.en: Sit tall, arms forward, don't lean back

reminders.zh: 每边都落稳成 90/90 再翻回去
reminders.en: Settle into 90/90 on each side before you switch back
